title: Bot Corp
tagline: A bot corporation - Provide a product requirement and an organisation made up entirely of bots (NFT gated prompt instances) generates the code for the product.
description:
The product allows users to 
a) Create a digital twin of any persona in a corporate role by providing a knowledge base and mint it as an NFT
b) Rent any of these bots into a Botcorp organisation to work for you
c) build any product you want with an army of bots who will deliver the right code and marketing strategy for you.
how_its_made:
The project forked Chatdev, a bot organisation and token gated access to every bot instance. 
It is built on Scroll, Polygon zkEVM and Mantle, where renting of the bot happens by purchasing the NFt and paying for it int he token on the respective chain. 

The bot organisation structure is created using Token bound accounts and 

We use vector embeddings to enable semantic search among a bots knowledge base which then gets fed into the bot organisation
